recent_excerpts: ETS breach exposed names, addresses, disability status and test results for all California public school students since 2023 — 5.7 million enrolled in 2025 alone.
Labcorp will pay $2.3 million and overhaul vendor oversight after the 2019 AMCA breach exposed 10.2 million patients; 44 state AGs announced the settlement Thursday.
ESET analysis shows 1 in 3 Android apps request unnecessary permissions — location, camera, microphone — enabling data harvesting and surveillance. Users should audit permissions.
